title: Commands Block Now Craftable
description: Craftable Command Blocks — A mod that enables crafting of all command block types, including minecart variants.
body:
🌟 Craftable Command Blocks (Neoforge 1.21.8)
This mod unlocks new possibilities in survival mode by allowing players to craft and use all types of command blocks without switching to Creative.

✨ Available Blocks:
📦 Command Block — the core of automation and custom gameplay.

🔄 Chain Command Block — executes commands in seamless loops for advanced mechanisms.

⏱️ Repeating Command Block — runs commands every tick for continuous control.

🚋 Command Block Minecart — a mobile version that brings commands to your rail systems.

🌌 Creative Freedom — unleash your imagination directly in survival mode.

🎮 Why It’s Useful:
Build automated systems and contraptions in survival.

Create mini-games and adventure maps without restrictions.

Balance between creative freedom and fair gameplay.

⚙️ Compatibility:
Fully supports Minecraft Neoforge 1.21.8.

Works seamlessly alongside other technical mods.
